blocks.text: They say history must never be forgotten. That is why Filipinos were taken back in time and reminded of the country’s revolutionary past as ‘Gabriela: The Musical’ took center stage at the Hyundai Hall, Areté, at the Ateneo de Manila University campus on November 13. Presented by Barefoot Theatre Collaborative, the musical portrayed Filipina revolutionary leader Gabriela Silang, played by renowned theater actress Gab Pangilinan, not merely as the widow of Diego Silang, played by Myke Salomon, but as a woman of her own identity, leadership, and strength. Meanwhile, Diego was a revolutionary leader who spearheaded the Ilocos uprising against Spanish […]...
